title: upstream: ask the Tasks authors to register Task/TaskList 'Supports History: Yes'
description:
Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H21. Crates: none. Size: S.

Decision 5 follow-up (docs/design/DECISIONS.md upstream list: 'Tasks: register Supports History: Yes'). Design: docs/design/object-history.md §2 (7.2 row), §4 (PENDING_HISTORY_REGISTRATION), §9 tasks bullet.

Fact: draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06 and the editor's source (~/GIT/jmapio-jmap/spec/tasks/ianaconsiderations.mdown) register capabilities but no JMAP Data Types entries. Under object-history-03 §7.2, Task and TaskList therefore default to 'No'.

Work: draft, for Mark to file, a jmapio/jmap issue or PR that adds JMAP Data Types registrations for TaskList, Task and TaskNotification. Supports History: Yes, Yes, No. Fill the other columns from the draft text.

The jmap-chat-spec memory 'jmap-tasks-dormant' (2026-11-02) says not to chase the dormant draft. Frame this as a registry addition alongside Mark's existing jmapio/jmap Tasks items, not as a question about whether the draft is alive. Do not send anything.

Acceptance:
- The draft text is handed to Mark.
- When a registration lands upstream, file an S bead to drop Task/TaskList from OHT PENDING_HISTORY_REGISTRATION and add the registry rows.
